Five-Star Boutique Dublin Heritage Escape

Dublin, Ireland

Discover the warm spirit and vibrant culture of Dublin, staying in five-star luxury at the historic Dylan Hotel. Housed in the former nurses' home for the Royal City of Dublin Hospital, this urban hotel effortlessly marries the building’s unique history and Victorian features with modern luxuries and boutique comforts. Nestled on a Victorian street in one of the city’s most sophisticated quarters, the hotel places you in an enviable location south of the river, within walking distance of popular Baggot Street’s pubs, shops and restaurants, and a 30-minute stroll from the city centre. (test) Behind the red-brick façade, a world of marble floors, heritage touches and Irish design awaits. Luxe facilities include The Eddison - an elegant restaurant with sunny verandas serving traditional Irish food - and the intimate Dylan Bar, the ideal place to enjoy carefully crafted cocktails and modern brunch fare. In summer, The Nurserie Terrace comes alive with spirited guests enjoying cool glasses of rosé. Each evening, cosy up in your boutique room or suite, offering luxe touches such as Nespresso coffee machines and a 'Good Food Ireland' hospitality tray with local treats. **Luxury Escapes inclusions (select packages)**: - **Daily à la carte breakfast** at The Eddison, serving pancakes, French toast and more - A **signature cocktail, glass of wine or beer on arrival** to celebrate your escape - **One three-course dinner** for two at The Eddison (stays of 3+ nights) - **Upgrade to the next room category**, subject to availability (stays of 5+ nights) **Want to elevate your stay?** Upgrade to a beautifully designed Experience Suite, with a lounge area, custom-made furniture and Irish-designed fabrics.
